pages.text: Use a stylus on an inscription table. Trace a guide, export the layer, then use its page on the overlay table.

Each element has twelve distinct schemes shared by all stylus and table tiers. Choose the element before drawing; Ctrl+Backspace clears a layer. In symbol mode place Creation in the center of every layer and other modifiers in the eight surrounding slots. Creation is required to export and cast.

Twelve layers are evenly divided across seven circles: I — 1–2; II — 3; III — 4–5; IV — 6–7; V — 8–9; VI — 10; VII — 11–12. Tool tiers unlock 2/3/5/7/9/10/12 layers in total. The weaker stylus or table determines access; older inaccessible drafts are preserved.
Open the overlay table with an empty hand. Add copies, move, rotate, resize and reorder them. Use a grimoire on the table to save a snapshot.
Select the saved spell in your grimoire. Sneak-use in the air to cast; use on a mana plate to display the circle.

Stylus tiers I–VII reveal 2/3/4/5/6/8/8 peripheral rings per layer. Central Creation is separate. The grimoire Schematics button shows reference drawings for the spell catalogue. Drawing requires matching stylus and table tiers.

Casting requires every distinct layer through the circle boundary: 2/3/5/7/9/10/12 pages. Order them by number and close a contour around Creation on each. Copies cannot replace missing numbers. Align sorts and centers the overlay. Incomplete compositions can remain drafts.
